account.title: Account
account.description: Voice input requires Streaming Speech Recognition 2.0. Recording transcription requires the standard or fast Recorded File Recognition service (either is sufficient; the standard service has no duration limit). Audio is sent to Doubao Speech for recognition.
apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Create a key under API Key Management in the console
resource.label: Billing resource
resource.description: Must match the resource enabled in the console
resource.duration.label: By duration
resource.duration.description: Billed by recognized audio duration; suitable for everyday personal use
resource.concurrent.label: By concurrency
resource.concurrent.description: Billed by purchased concurrent channels; enable this separately in the console
